sermon.title: Disarming Doctrines that Cause Many USA Christians to Lose Their Will to Fight  — September 20, 2020
sermon.speaker: Pastor David G. Kincer
sermon.summary: Pastor David G. Kincer names doctrines that disarm American Christians: Satan’s lie that he controls the nations, silence under the Johnson Amendment, misuse of “resist not evil,” reducing the gospel to helping the poor, and once saved always saved. Mature believers keep God’s commandments and stand up for the oppressed.
sermon.transcript_source: This transcript comes from YouTube’s automatic English captions, which supply the timing and the words. Punctuation, capitalization and paragraphing were added from the speaker’s pauses and then corrected by hand, and obvious caption errors (names, Bible references) were fixed; his wording was not rewritten. “[unclear]” marks a word or name that was not clear.
